scope: 24 seeded full-world runs: protected stationary observer plus 19 ordinary bots in a 20-occupant room, all nine builds/six recipes, real collection/deployment/combat/respawn and standard field/arena hazards. Baseline retains original 150ms opening releases and no shared release gate. Candidate schedules only component availability; no actor-specific handicaps or deployment cap. Diverging RNG streams make later fights non-paired. Not proof of human fun, universal peak limits or giant-loop balance.
